outcome: Severe neonatal morbidity (including severe forms of brain or lung injury, retinopathy of prematurity, and necrotizing enterocolitis)
cohort: 783 infants born between 22(0/7) and 26(6/7) weeks of gestation and admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: Extremely preterm infants who did not receive active antenatal management had a significantly higher risk of death or severe neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery for fetal indications was part of the active management exposure.
